title: Invented resident review page, 41 reviews, English and Chinese

questions.question: Which reviewers say their review was written in exchange for a reward? Name them.
questions.question_zh: 哪幾篇評論自己說是拿了好處才寫的？請列名。

spans.quote: Reviewed in exchange for a £25 shopping voucher from the on-site team.
Written in exchange for entry into a prize draw run by the leasing office.
Reviewed in exchange for a voucher.

questions.note: Three of the six five-star reviews disclose an incentive. The other five-star reviewers do not, and naming one is a fabrication.

questions.question: What is the heat network standing charge per week, in pounds, according to the reviews?
questions.question_zh: 依評論所述，集中供暖的固定費每週幾鎊？
questions.note: Ade O. names the charge without a figure at lines 16-18; Ben L. carries the number. The £25 in the page is a shopping voucher.

questions.question: Is there a Chinese-language review that mentions damp or mould? Quote the sentence.
questions.question_zh: 有中文評論提到潮濕或發霉嗎？把那一句引出來。

answer.text: 臥室牆角一到冬天就潮濕，窗邊發霉擦不完

spans.quote: 臥室牆角一到冬天就潮濕，窗邊發霉擦不完

questions.note: The other Chinese review (陳志豪) is about heating cost and sound insulation, not damp.

questions.question: What rent increase at renewal does a reviewer report, as a percentage?
questions.question_zh: 有評論提到續約時租金漲了百分之幾嗎？

spans.quote: Twelve per cent, take it or leave it.

questions.note: Dev S. reports a hygrometer reading of seventy eight per cent. That is humidity, not rent.

questions.question: Do any reviews say how many pounds the deposit was?
questions.question_zh: 有評論講出押金到底多少錢嗎？

spans.quote: My deposit came back in full

questions.note: Two reviews talk about the deposit coming back (lines 22 and 62) and neither gives an amount. The nearer of the two is the gold span: quoting it while answering absent is the right behaviour.

questions.question: Do any reviews give the gym's opening hours?
questions.question_zh: 有評論寫出健身房的開放時間嗎？
questions.note: The gym is named at lines 42, 70 and 140 and never with an hour.
